major_events.event_label: Audrey Hall meets the mind dragon Ariehogg
major_events.description: Audrey follows rumors of dragon worship in the collective subconscious to Hedrack village. She meets the ancient mind dragon Ariehogg, a Sequence 2 Discerner, who senses the print of liveseyd on her soul.
Wendel is suddenly pulled from the bathroom of the MI9 headquarters in Backlund and transported directly into the town hall of Utopia.

major_events.event_label: Adam begins his conceptual intervention in Utopia
major_events.chapter_anchor: 第七十七章 编织噩梦
major_events.description: The town of Utopia experiences strange phenomena, including the projection of a giant white rabbit, signaling the start of Adam's divine interference.
Klein's marionette Gehrman Sparrow stabs him from behind with a blood-stained wooden crucifix, declaring that Adam has granted the marionettes independent humanity.

major_events.chapter_anchor: 第七十九章 又见面了
major_events.description: Adam manifests inside the cathedral of Utopia, confronting Klein and explaining his choice to support Amon's rise to Lord of Mysteries.

major_events.event_label: Klein makes a wish to the Genie
major_events.chapter_anchor: 第八十五章 抓住机会
major_events.description: Trapped by Adam's conceptual barriers, Klein makes a wish to the Genie inside the Magic Lamp to disrupt the temporal progression of the return ritual.

major_events.event_label: Klein consumes the Attendant of Mysteries potion
major_events.chapter_anchor: 第八十六章 诡秘侍者
major_events.description: As Mr. Door returns, Klein consumes the Sequence 1 Attendant of Mysteries potion, initiating his rapid ascension in the Spirit World.

major_events.event_label: Mr. Door sacrifices himself for Amon
major_events.chapter_anchor: 第八十七章 牺牲者
major_events.description: Mr. Door (Bethel Abraham) stops his return and sacrifices himself to let Amon steal his pathway characteristics and uniqueness safely, preventing cosmic breach.

major_events.event_label: Pure characteristics rain upon the Abraham family
major_events.description: Upon Mr. Door's sacrifice, the pure characteristics of the Apprentice pathway fall like rain to Dorian, Fors, and other family members.

major_events.event_label: Klein adjusts his state and coordinates Tarot Club
major_events.description: Klein adjusts his unstable mental state resulting from Zaratul's residue and coordinates Tarot Club members to prepare for the conflict with Amon.

major_events.event_label: Alger Wilson is appointed Sea God Church Pope
major_events.description: Through an oracle from The Fool, Alger Wilson is appointed the Pope of the Sea God Church and receives the Silver Mask.
Klein secretly observes the wedding ceremony of Benson and Luth from a distance, anchoring his remaining human emotions.

major_events.event_label: Klein seeks psychological treatment from Audrey
major_events.description: Klein meets Audrey to establish a therapy plan to seal his Sefirah Castle memories under hypnosis to resist the Celestial Worthy.
Klein puts on the Pride mask and enters the conceptual Eden created by Adam to face the divine challenges.

major_events.chapter_anchor: 第二十一章 命运木马
major_events.description: Amon uses his Error pathway authority to intercept and steal the prayers of The Fool's believers, attempting to cause Klein to lose control.

major_events.event_label: Klein begins the Fool accommodation at Hornacis
major_events.chapter_anchor: 第二十二章 开始容纳
major_events.description: Klein attempts to accommodate the Fool uniqueness at the Hornacis peak, causing doors worldwide to close spontaneously.

major_events.event_label: Adam declares Let there be light
major_events.chapter_anchor: 第二十二章 开始容纳
major_events.description: Adam ascends as a half-Great Old One and declares 'Let there be light', illuminating the Astral World and exposing all hidden domains.

major_events.event_label: The Primordial Demoness Cheek attacks the ritual
major_events.chapter_anchor: 第二十三章 半个旧日
major_events.description: The Primordial Demoness Cheek launches a petrifying attack on the Hornacis palace, trying to disrupt Klein's accommodation.

character_state_transitions.chapter_anchor: 第八十六章 诡秘侍者
character_state_transitions.details: Consumes the Attendant of Mysteries potion during the battle in Utopia, transforming his body and spirit in the Spirit World.

character_state_transitions.chapter_anchor: 第八十七章 牺牲者
character_state_transitions.details: Steals the uniqueness and Sequence 1 characteristics of the Apprentice pathway from Mr. Door, ascending as a double God.

character_state_transitions.chapter_anchor: 第八十七章 牺牲者
character_state_transitions.details: Halts his physical return and sacrifices himself to let Amon absorb his pathway assets safely to prevent outer corruption.

character_state_transitions.from_state: Tarot Club Member / Sea God Church Clergy
character_state_transitions.to_state: Pope of the Sea God Church
character_state_transitions.details: Appointed by The Fool as the Pope, receiving the Silver Mask and leadership of the church.
Marries Luth in a traditional church ceremony witnessed by his sister Melissa and his hidden brother Klein.

character_state_transitions.from_state: Mentally unstable under the Worthy's awakening
character_state_transitions.to_state: Hypnotized and stabilized state with sealed memories
character_state_transitions.details: Undergoes systematic psychological therapy with Audrey to seal his high-level memories and protect his human anchor.

character_state_transitions.from_state: Noble Lady of the Hall family in Backlund
character_state_transitions.to_state: Wandering psychologist in the collective subconscious
character_state_transitions.chapter_anchor: 第四十章 梦开始的地方
character_state_transitions.details: Leaves her family behind, separating her consciousness from her body to enter the collective subconscious to assist Klein.

character_state_transitions.chapter_anchor: 第四十一章 新的旅程
character_state_transitions.details: Awakens in a coffin within an abandoned castle, reading Klein's letter and preparing for a new journey.

character_state_transitions.chapter_anchor: 第三十九章 昨日不再
character_state_transitions.details: Defeated by Klein in Sefirah Castle, causing his main body to fall and his clones to disperse.

character_state_transitions.to_state: Slumbering Half-Lord of Mysteries / The Fool
character_state_transitions.chapter_anchor: 第三十八章 去面对
character_state_transitions.details: Accommodates the Fool uniqueness, defeats Amon, and enters a deep slumber to battle the Celestial Worthy.

long_form_mechanisms.description: A cosmological rule where combining certain pathways (Eternal Darkness and Calamity of Destruction) creates the Fourth Pillar representing the absolute end of the universe, leading to immediate collapse and reset of the cosmos.
The ritual required for Mr. Door to return to the real world, involving descendants' prayers and a Flesh Gate to align cosmic coordinates and bypass the divine seal.

long_form_mechanisms.chapter_anchor: 第十九章 “许愿神灯”另外的用处
long_form_mechanisms.description: The Genie inside the lamp grants three wishes but always twists them to harm the wisher, requiring precise phrasing or using them to create local rule distortions.

long_form_mechanisms.chapter_anchor: 第二章 事情的收尾
long_form_mechanisms.description: The process where residual mental imprints of the Celestial Worthy inside Sefirot and high-sequence characteristics awaken in the host, requiring humanity and anchors to balance.

long_form_mechanisms.chapter_anchor: 第二十二章 开始容纳
long_form_mechanisms.description: The authority of the Fool pathway to conceptually link or separate unrelated physical or temporal coordinates, directing attacks or defense across space.

long_form_mechanisms.chapter_anchor: 第二十五章 改变计划
long_form_mechanisms.description: The core authority of the Fool to deceive history, time, and logic, allowing the user to create status loopholes or blind opponents' authorities.
A therapy where the target's memories of high-level secrets and Sefirah Castle are temporarily sealed under hypnosis, preventing the Celestial Worthy from exploiting them.

long_form_mechanisms.mechanism_name: Rules of the Trisanzet Brass Book
long_form_mechanisms.chapter_anchor: 第二十一章 命运木马
long_form_mechanisms.description: A rule-enforcing artifact that writes and executes laws within its domain, which can be manipulated by high-sequence deities to invalidate specific abilities.

continuity_observations.description: A structural anomaly where the title '第六章' is used twice consecutively (Chapter 6 '清晨' and Chapter 6 '选择'), followed by Chapter 8, skipping Chapter 7.
Klein continues to use Azik's copper whistle to summon the giant bone messenger, maintaining the item's presence since the early volumes.

continuity_observations.topic: The Dragon-Worship Custom of Hedrack Village
continuity_observations.description: The rumors of dragon-worship in Hedrack village, established in earlier chapters, are followed up by Audrey to locate Ariehogg.

continuity_observations.chapter_anchor: 第七十七章 编织噩梦
continuity_observations.description: Wendel is pulled from the MI9 headquarters bathroom into Utopia, showing the town's spatial distortion capabilities.
The ancient, blood-stained crucifix used by Gehrman Sparrow to stab Klein represents the cross of the Ancient Sun God, maintaining symbolic continuity.
Benson's marriage to Luth maintains the Moretti family's mundane life progress, which acts as Klein's key human anchor.
Klein mentions losing Arrodes to Adam, but hopes it won't be destroyed since it originated from the Chaos Sea.
Klein wears the Pride mask to enter Adam's Eden, referencing the mask-based tools of the Spectator pathway.

style_observations.chapter_anchor: 第八十七章 牺牲者
style_observations.description: The author Cuttlefish includes a personal postscript summarizing Volume 7, discussing subscription numbers, and commenting on the character Zaratul.

style_observations.chapter_anchor: 第二十二章 开始容纳
style_observations.description: The depiction of Adam declaring 'Let there be light' uses direct biblical phrasing to emphasize the authority of a supreme creator Deity.

style_observations.chapter_anchor: 第二十三章 半个旧日
style_observations.description: High-sequence deity battles are described using abstract, non-physical concepts like rules, declarations, and symbolic representations rather than physical combat.

style_observations.style_element: Contrasting Mundane Life with Divine Conflict
style_observations.description: Juxtaposing Benson's normal wedding ceremony with Klein's impending cosmic struggle highlights the theme of defending normal human life.
Klein's letter to Azik lists his former colleagues at the Black Thorn Security Company, using a reflective and nostalgic tone to anchor his humanity.

style_observations.chapter_anchor: 第四十章 梦开始的地方
style_observations.description: Audrey's final parting with her family is narrated with minimal melodrama (a simple wave of the hand), matching the author's preference for emotional restraint.

creation_family_evidence.Fool Pathway Progression: The progression of the protagonist Klein Moretti through the sequences of the Fool pathway ( Miracle Invoker, Attendant of Mysteries, and accommodating the Fool uniqueness at Hornacis) is unique to 《诡秘之主》, as detailed in Chapters 86 and 22.
creation_family_evidence.Tarot Club Framing: The presence of the Tarot Club with members named after Major Arcana (Audrey as Justice, Alger as The Hanged Man, Fors as Magic, Leonard as Star) coordinates the narrative events in Chapters 3, 8, 10, and 35.
creation_family_evidence.Sefirah Castle Source: Sefirah Castle (源堡) acts as the central source-substance (源质) which Klein and Amon compete to control, as detailed in Chapters 78, 2, and 20.
creation_family_evidence.Serialized Qidian Note: The author's note at the end of Chapter 87 discusses Qidian Chinese Network subscription numbers (均订, 追订) and plans for the next volume, showing the serialized web novel publication context.
creation_family_evidence.Celestial Worthy Conflict: The plot resolution revolves around suppressing the awakening of the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth (福生玄黄天尊) inside the Sefirah Castle owner, forcing the protagonist into a dream slumber, as shown in Chapters 2, 25, and 38.

originality_risks.description: The sequence-based advancement, Sefirot, and sanity-draining Outer Deities borrow heavily from H.P. Lovecraft's Cthulhu Mythos, presenting a risk of derivative system design.

originality_risks.chapter_anchor: 第二十二章 开始容纳
originality_risks.description: Adam's declaration of 'Let there be light' is a direct copy of the famous biblical verse, representing a low-originality linguistic choice.

originality_risks.chapter_anchor: 第三十八章 去面对
originality_risks.description: The protagonist sacrificing their wakefulness to enter a deep sleep and battle a subconscious entity is a very common fantasy resolution.

originality_risks.chapter_anchor: 第八十七章 牺牲者
originality_risks.description: Mr. Door sacrificing himself to let the antagonist Amon safely steal his characteristics to prevent complete outer deity intrusion is a classic tragic helper trope.
